purpose: Fixed 100 versus 300 epoch training-fit comparison, not validation or deployment selection
selection_rule: Final epoch 300 for each of the same six fits; no best-checkpoint selection or early stopping
limits: Inherit the exact panel, features, scaler, model widths, normalization, class weights and all optimizer settings
Only extend duration; preserve Adam state and epoch-specific shuffling through epoch 100
Stop a fit before epoch 101 if its full 100-epoch prefix does not match
No tree refit, production change, cloud training or held-out evaluation
